title: docs(qa): add cross-cutting UX convention items to the platform checklist
body:
## Summary

On the maintainer's instruction — 「写进测试清单：把这些原则加到 docs/qa/platform-checklist/，例如"每个写操作都有反馈""每个禁用控件都说明原因""不对用户显示机器名"。这样以后每轮测试都会检查。」 — this adds one area, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`, with three items so every checklist run samples these conventions across the console and Studio:

- `ux-conventions.write-feedback` — every user-initiated write answers visibly: success names what changed, a refusal says why, a no-op claims nothing, and Undo restores where a surface offers it.
- `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` — every disabled control shows its reason on hover and on keyboard focus, and exposes it as an accessible description.
- `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` — where a label exists users see it; machine names, raw ids and spec paths appear only as secondary text.

Each item lists the rows known to fail on stock in `knownGaps`, citing the objectui cards filed from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass, so a run scores them fail and cites the card instead of re-filing. `FOLLOW-UPS.md` section 11 registers those rows (F1–F8) and three open decisions for the maintainer: P1 vs P0 (whether these join every release sweep), which writes should offer Undo, and whether direct manipulation needs a toast. `scripts/checklist-symbol-anchor-baseline.json` gains a floor for the new area file at the count `--anchor-census` measured (8) — a new floor, no floor lowered.

Scope: a scoped authoring by one reader, grounded in a source reading on `main` and the browser pass — not a five-angle sweep, so it makes no claim about what else is missing.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` — exit 0: selector self-test 31 cases, validator self-test 221 assertions, ledger OK (16 areas, 279 items, 18 file floors held).
- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs area:ux-conventions` — resolves the three items as runnable.
- `node scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` — exit 0 (this required gate reads `docs/qa/`).

## Changeset

A QA ledger and its anchor baseline only — nothing publishes from a released package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
